integrity: An unrestricted analytic proof is supplied; finite checks are supplementary. No independent scientific review has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Optimizer ranges over positive direct-leaf counts for mixed spiders with fixed k; it is not an optimum over all trees of the same order.
The exact greedy-law probability q_j and the order-of-growth upper bound for a particular leaf count are credited to Fairfax-Ball (2026).
Priority may be affected by unindexed work on random sequential adsorption or optimal total-variation tuning.
title: Unique optimal leaf tuning for near-uniform random greedy mixed spiders
